_provenance: P2 architect merge, esp32c3-node, 2026-10-01. Sources: research/power.json (rails, copper, thermal), research/interface-usb-fs.json (diff pair, high_speed), research/refdesign-esp32c3-module.json (straps, antenna keep-out), research/refdesign-charger-loadshare.json (power path), research/{module,charger,ldo,sensor-io}.json (parts). Power nets are bare (power symbols); /USB_DP, /USB_DM, /VBAT_SENSE are root-level labels.

power._notes: Default-USB entitlement. CAP RULE: C1 4.7 uF at J1 + charger input; receptacle total stays <= 10 uF.
ESP32-C3 WiFi TX peak 350 mA + Qwiic reserve 100 mA.

diff_pairs._notes: No impedance_ohm: 90 ohm is not achievable on 1.6 mm 2L at sane widths and USB-FS at 12 Mb/s over < 30 mm does not need it (interface-usb-fs research). Route coupled, over unbroken B.Cu GND.
diff_pairs._impedance_notes: P5: NOT a controlled target. rules_gen defaults a missing impedance_ohm to 90, which on JLC2313 1.6 mm 2L solves to 1.09 mm traces (unroutable into the module/USB-C pads). 140 ohm is what the natural 0.20 mm / 0.30 mm coupled pair over B.Cu GND actually is; USB-FS over < 30 mm tolerates it (P1 interface research).

thermal._notes: RT9080-33 SOT-23-5, worst sustained 0.32 W per research/power.json (VSYS 4.9 V on USB); theta-JA 230.6 C/W -> Tj ~114 C at 40 C ambient worst. GND pin to B.Cu pour with >= 2 vias.

placement._edges_notes: U1 antenna end AT the top edge (overhang preferred, module datasheet placement option); the datasheet antenna keep-out carries no copper on any layer and no parts. J1 at the opposite edge so the USB cable and battery lead never sit near the antenna. J2/J3 on free side edges; J4/J5 edge pads along the long sides (P6 geometry).

separation.reason: BME280 self-heating error from module/LDO/charger copper conduction; no pour under U5.

sides.reason: Qwiic cable mates from the top

placement._mounting_notes: No mounting holes (requirements section 5): board_init must not add default holes.

blocks.name: J1 USB-C 2.0 sink, 5.1k Rd x2, SMF5.0A VBUS TVS, USBLC6-2SC6 on D+/D-
U2 MCP73831-2 linear 1S charger + AO3401A/B5819W load-sharing power path
U1 ESP32-C3-MINI-1-N4 module (PCB antenna), native USB-Serial-JTAG
U5 BME280 T/RH/P, I2C 0x76, shared with Qwiic J3

_notes_planes: P7: owner style asks for GND pours on both layers with stitching.
